_comment: Permanent awards. Flavour only, no mechanical effect. Language follows the tempering theme: load and recovery, never punishment.

titles.name: Tempered
titles.condition: Log a rest day after three consecutive training days

titles.name: Returned
titles.condition: Train again after four or more days away

titles.name: The Unhurried
titles.condition: Sleep in the seven-to-nine band twenty times

titles.name: Well-Tempered
titles.condition: Reach level 4 in all five attributes

titles.name: A Year Under Load
titles.condition: Train across 365 days from first session
